limitations: Scope-covering budget sensitivities are not complete engineered estimates; rates, sites, taxes, customs, inflation and construction risk need local appraisal.
Constant USD with real financing-rate hypotheses; no exchange-rate forecast, tax, revenue, subsidy, grant, fare or guaranteed regeneration assumed.

Loss allowance per fixed-zone event includes a provisional winding/conversion/cooling provision; it is not a measured map. The drive study retains 7.18kWh urban terminal copper heat alone. No free paired-train regeneration.
Missed traction data holds energy OPEX and finance; equivalent circuits are not a complete start/end or disturbed timetable. Reserves and depot movements need their own duty.
Staff counts are paid FTE allowances across shifts; GOA4 removes no station, control-room, rescue or maintenance duty by itself.
Comparator uses identical service quantities and assumed CAPEX/OPEX multipliers with the same debt rate/tenor/fraction; it is not a priced metro alternative or proven saving.
Foreign-currency debt fraction is an independent finance assumption, not imported content or accepted localisation. UKEF eligibility is contract-specific and unconfirmed.
Land-value, access, employment, productivity and travel-time benefits remain unmonetised pending catchments, OD demand, counterfactual and displacement assessment.

Close coupling pitch, full magnetic lifting-face/guidance-arm/below-floor swept envelope, door/egress layouts, actual mass and equal AW2/AW3 qualification. The 2.65 m cabin width does not bound running gear or platform clearance.
Obtain force/loss maps and rig correlation, six-axis stability, target timing and independent support/capture/braking protection.
Locate fixed loops/ring closure, qualify curvature, clearance and land, and provide switch-free failure recovery.

Locate the predominantly elevated straight-tangent proposal and verify buildings/air rights, road/utility clearance, wildlife/water passage, piers, station/egress and construction access; no zero-impact claim from elevation alone.

Place charging interfaces and prove taper, power quality, PV/storage/backup sizing and adverse-weather replenishment.
Locate line-local storage/workshops and qualify depot-only connection/transfer, isolation, inspection, towing and recovery.
Price all station/land/loop/bridge/at-grade/depot/energy/control/production/QA/NRE/spares/OPEX scope, origin-trace MBOM and apply EPC once.
Close G0–G5 through authenticated independent physical acceptance; planning arithmetic is insufficient.
